messages:
alex: heads-up — spotted a weird parity edge with the .NET and TS SDKs + sample-app rerank. batching helper pads with a null-sentinel and after an auth-refresh+retry one embedding is truncated by 1 float.

alex: repro (quick): send 3 items, helper pads to 4, expire token mid-flight to force refresh+retry. sometimes the last embedding has length 127 instead of 128 (model says 128).

alex: minimal .NET snippet:
```csharp
var resp = await client.Embeddings.CreateAsync(new EmbeddingsRequest {
  Model = "embed-128",
  Input = new[] { "s1", "s2", "s3" } // batcher pads to 4 with null sentinel
});
```

alex: response (sanitized):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...128 floats...]},{"embedding":[...128...]},{"embedding":[...128...]},{"embedding":[...127 floats...]}]}
```

priya: thanks — pattern sounds familiar: mutable pad metadata + auth-retry reconstructing requests from a shared buffer. which helper/export are you using?

alex: sample-app uses devex-batcher v0.9.0 where we mark padded rows with "__nullPad": true and leave a placeholder null vector in the payload. The queue stores a reference to the original request array instead of a snapshot.

chris: that explains it. on retry the original buffer may have been altered (or reused) and the null sentinel encoding path ends up encoding one fewer float in the last element. quickly: can you verify if the client logged a 401 -> refresh -> replay?

alex: yep logs: 
```
[auth] 401 token expired -> refresh
[batcher] replaying batch id=1123 (shallow ref)
[client] assembling embeddings for batch id=1123
```

ben: immediate mitigation: SDKs should assert embedding length == model_profile.dim at assembly time and throw a clear EmbeddingShapeError with request_id + suggested remediation. that will surface the bug instead of silently corrupting rerank results.

priya: agreed. long-term fixes: (1) batch helper must deep-clone request & pad metadata when enqueuing for send; (2) auth/retry path must preserve associated metadata snapshot instead of referencing mutable buffers; (3) runtime to include explicit top-level metadata in /v1/embeddings response: { "embedding_dim": N, "request_id": "..." } and per-item "source_index" so clients can remap.

chris: also worth adding a small client-side remapping step: if response includes per-item source_index we can align scores for rerank by that index instead of assuming positional alignment. that avoids silent misalignment when ordering or filtering occurs server-side.

alex: good point — rerank currently zips scores to embeddings by index; if a pad gets removed or ordering flips, the scores map incorrectly and results are garbage without an obvious error.

ben: filed DE-5342: "null-pad snapshot lost on auth-retry -> short embedding (.NET/TS)" with logs + repro. devex-bot created the issue and added PR template.

devex-bot: created issue DE-5342: "null-pad snapshot lost on auth-retry -> short embedding (.NET/TS)" and attached repro steps.

priya: plan: patch batcher to snapshot pad metadata at enqueue (non-breaking), add EmbeddingShapeError check in SDK assembly (fail-fast), add telemetry event embed.shape_mismatch. ship canary for .NET/TS by EOD.

chris: server request: runtime should add embedding_dim and optional per-item source_index in the JSON body on /v1/embeddings 200 responses. that will make client validation language-agnostic. cc @eng-runtime.

alex: i'll update the sample-app to handle EmbeddingShapeError gracefully and retry at app-level if it occurs, until runtime change lands. also adding a reproducible unit test that forces token expiry mid-batch.

ben: test matrix: .NET/TS/Python x batch_size 2..8 x pad_pos head/mid/tail x token-expire-at-byte. want telemetry counts < 1 after fix.

priya: adding CI job that injects auth-failures at send-time and asserts no shape mismatches. will link to DE-5342.

chris: small UX thought: error message should include expected/got dims + request_id + hint: "upgrade batcher to snapshot pad metadata or retry after verifying SDK version". keeps user dev/debug time low.

alex: agreed. will include suggested commands for sample-app repro in the issue.

devex-bot: linked PR template and CI job to DE-5342.

ben: i'll draft the .NET patch (snapshot + len-check) and a TS shim that mirrors behavior. target canary tomorrow morning.

alex: thanks all — will validate canary and close DE-5342 once CI + sample-app pass. :thumbsup:
